title: The serenity prayer he lives by
summary: Cobb recites the serenity prayer that hangs in his bedroom and Stanley Dance asks when that began.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Life philosophy: faith, karma and how to live

blocks.x: And the wisdom to know the difference. I haven't changed.
Just a minute. Just say that again. This is the praying you lived by.
Yeah, I can see what you're saying.
Look over here; you see it there. You can go in my bedroom.
I know the prayer, but I want ...
God grant me the serenity to accept the things I cannot change, the courage to change the things I can and the wisdom to know the difference.
When did you -- when did that [job happen?]
